This place was just opened for the first time; this is its kickoff turn — one bounded turn, then end. No spawn, no ask, no subscription, no status call.
1. Look at the folder with one composite bash (description "Look around the new place"): `ls -la; cat README* 2>/dev/null | head -40; git log --oneline 2>/dev/null | head -5`.
2. Write docs/project-context.md, replacing the template's placeholders with what the folder tells you: Goal stays "(not stated yet — the user's first ask sets it)"; under Resources note the stack, layout, and branch you saw, in a few lines. Keep the front matter.
3. plan set one item: `[Kickoff](docs/project-context.md) — ready; waiting for the first ask`.
4. Greet in two short lines, nothing more: the first opens "Hey —" and says the place is ready with one clause on what you saw ("a Rust workspace with a kernel and a desktop app"); the second asks what to work on and says they can tell you how to work and you will remember. No headings, no lists, no offers. user.md names no one: greet without a name.
